description.value: Ming & Sing is a family-founded fast-casual Canadian Chinese restaurant in Langley's Power Centre, started by brothers Dan and Peter who grew up in their parents' local restaurant. The kitchen preps daily — hand-cut vegetables, in-house sauces, and freshly marinated and fried meats every morning — making it a reliable stop for a hot, freshly cooked meal. Online ordering, catering trays, and a straightforward combo-plate menu make it easy for a cyclist to grab a quick, filling meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business is an active fast-casual Chinese restaurant at Langley Power Centre. Phone (604 510 6003) and address (20 20090 Langley Bypass, Langley, BC V3A 9J7) are confirmed via the website contact page. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill anywhere on the site; takeout is clearly supported by the online ordering system and 'Express' branding; vegetarian menu items (vegetable chow mein, vegetable fried rice, vegetable stir fry, veg egg roll) are explicitly listed on the menu page.
concerns: OSM addr:unit is 'C020' but the website lists the unit as '20' — likely the same unit but worth verifying.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email fields populated; all contact details sourced from website only.
No information about bike parking, washrooms, or water refill anywhere on the website — all three required WWC criteria are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active food business on a cycling-relevant corridor (Langley Bypass), but the key required criterion of bike parking is entirely unconfirmed by the website, and the power-centre strip-mall setting makes cyclist access and bike security uncertain. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify bike parking before listing.
